# Test fixtures

Frozen copies of real upstream data, used only by tests. They are never served by any API route.

| File | Source | Retrieved (UTC) |
|---|---|---|
| `iss-25544-2026-10-19.json` | `https://celestrak.org/NORAD/elements/gp.php?CATNR=25544&FORMAT=JSON` | 2026-10-19 00:18:56 |
| `vallado/SGP4-VER.TLE`, `vallado/*.e` | SGP4 verification cases and C++ reference ephemerides (TEME, km, km/s; time in seconds from epoch) from Vallado, Crawford, Hujsak & Kelso, *Revisiting Spacetrack Report #3*, AIAA 2006-6753. Extracted unchanged from `sgp4/cpp/testsgp4/TestSGP4/` in `https://celestrak.org/publications/AIAA/2006-6753/AIAA-2006-6753.zip` (sha256 `3642043b…adc115`). | 2026-10-19 |
| `omm-sample-2026-10-19.json` | 12 records copied unchanged from the `GROUP=active` download `https://celestrak.org/NORAD/elements/gp.php?GROUP=active&FORMAT=JSON` (ISS, CSS, HST, GEO, inclined GSO, Meridian/Molniya, GPS, two sun-synchronous, Chandra with a future epoch, two 6-digit objects) | 2026-10-19 00:31:07 |
| `reference-skyfield.json` | Generated by `scripts/gen_reference.py` from `omm-sample-2026-10-19.json` with python-sgp4 (TEME) and Skyfield + JPL DE421 (frames, look angles, passes, Sun, Earth shadow). Versions are recorded in the file. | see file |
